body:
Tested locally on https://github.com/Calinou/platshoot, this causes the project to not run at all when pressing <kbd>F5</kbd>. This happens because the Enabled checkbox is `false` by default for the only run instance out there:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e9212b50-e11b-4ff3-8ba1-efae8c8b1333)

This occurs even if **Enable Multiple Instances** is unchecked.

Also, when creating a new instance, it's disabled by default. We should ensure all newly created instances are enabled by default, along for existing instances in existing projects.

Lastly, we should ensure it's not possible to uncheck *all* instances and that at least one instance must remain checked at all times.
